scripts.build: npm run build:cli && npm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:extension
scripts.phase1: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js phase1 --icon assets/firefox-dog.png
scripts.phase1:dry-run: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js phase1 --icon assets/firefox-dog.png --dry-run
scripts.phase2: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js phase2
scripts.phase2:dry-run: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js phase2 --dry-run
scripts.spotify-art: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js spotify-art
scripts.install-firefox-host: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js install-firefox-host
scripts.watch-firefox: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js watch-firefox
scripts.watch-firefox:dry-run: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js watch-firefox --dry-run
